title: Inter dimensional hotel of sorts
content: This is a new location for me that I have not seen before. It starts with me being taken out of the world we know and put into a world were the currency is just called Credits. At some point I and a couple other people make our way to a hotel. In this hotel all of us are given the same room number and told to enter one at a time. The floors are perfectly circular and it seems to go upwards forever. After the first person walks in I wait for the door to close and walk in the door. I look around it’s an ordinary enough hotel room, but the first person isn’t inside anywhere. I search everywhere and nobody. Just as I’m freaking out they call me on some kind of watch gadget I think and they tell me we can merge our hotel rooms into one if we would like. We take up the same physical space, however the dimensional space is separate. Right as I’m about to merge my room with one of my companions that I believe was a love interest in the dream I woke up.
